# Shruthi Matrimony / Become Worth

An independent creative experiment by Moses Sam Paul Johnraj, presented as an experiment of Internet of Value Research Foundation. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Shruti Haasan and does not offer dates or introductions. Seraphina is a fictional dragon goddess.

Become Worth is a proposed 90-day journey: Monster, Divine, Integration, 30 days each. Signup records interest, not enrolment in a scheduled cohort. Current HouseOfBros self-guided trails are separate linked resources.
